item.title: Iran's supreme leader severely disfigured by US strikes: report
item.summary: Iranian Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei is severely disfigured after U.S.-Israel airstrikes on Tehran killed his father, according to a Reuters report citing anonymous sources.

item.title: Iran regime uses former Soviet republic to dodge sanctions, fund war machine: report
item.summary: Once a committed U.S. ally, Georgia has quietly aligned with Iran, raising concerns about IRGC influence and sanctions evasion, a new report claims.

item.title: Iran’s ‘Godfather of propaganda’ tactics resurface in war with US and Israel
item.summary: Experts say Iran uses civilians and children as human shields for propaganda purposes, caring nothing for the safety and fate of its own people.

item.title: Inside Tehran after strikes: Iranian woman describes fear, checkpoints and people used as ‘human shields’
item.summary: An anonymous Iranian woman detailed to The Australian the nightly explosions, celebrations and fear in Tehran as Trump's two-week ceasefire with Iran tentatively took hold.

item.title: Israeli man built bomb lab for Iranian plot targeting ex-PM Bennett, authorities say
item.summary: A Haifa man was allegedly recruited by an Iranian handler to build bombs for an assassination plot believed to target ex-PM Naftali Bennett.

item.title: Miner rescued alive after spending nearly 2 weeks trapped underground in flooded area
item.summary: A Mexican miner was rescued after spending 13 days trapped underground, officials said, while one miner was found dead and another remains missing.

item.title: Chief prosecutor behind Israel war crimes charges faces disciplinary action amid sexual misconduct allegations
item.summary: ICC Chief Prosecutor Karim Khan faces disciplinary proceedings over alleged sexual misconduct after the Bureau of the Assembly of States Parties voted to move forward with action.

item.title: Iran threatens to end ceasefire over Hezbollah's exclusion from truce deal
item.summary: Iran says the U.S. must choose between ceasefire or war via Israel as Tuesday's ceasefire deal excludes Tehran-backed terrorist group Hezbollah.

item.title: UK's NATO show of force ends with docked destroyer in Mediterranean after 'technical' issue
item.summary: The U.K. docked its sole naval warship in the Mediterranean due to technical issues amid growing criticism of PM Starmer's response to the Iran war.

item.title: Evangelical leaders rally for Trump and Israel as Operation Epic Fury reshapes the region
item.summary: Evangelical leaders say support for Israel has remained strong during Operation Epic Fury, the joint U.S.-Israel military campaign against Iran, as a new ceasefire takes hold.
